8: /// <summary>
9: /// FR/TR: RUNTIME-TAPE-002 / TR-TAP-EDGE-001.
10: /// Use case: The Datasette sense line and record mode.
11: ///
12: /// SENSE line: The SENSE signal from the Datasette is physically connected to
13: /// CIA1 Port B bit 4 ($DC01 bit 4). When the PLAY or RECORD button is
14: /// pressed, SENSE goes low (bit 4 = 0). When no button is pressed, SENSE
15: /// is high (bit 4 = 1). The managed Datasette exposes this via a SenseLine
16: /// property: true = not-pressed (high), false = pressed (low).
17: /// VICE datasette/datasette.c: sense line state driven by PLAY/RECORD state.
